strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction (Intra+Inter Node)

Assuming ~28 nodes × 8 devices, this yields 16 dispatches (8 stages × 2 levels) but with smaller intra-node collectives and reduced cross-node bandwidth pressure.
